decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has a page of its own and sits close to the core offer, and its value is still uncertain after only one year, so the option is cheap to keep open.
The hyaluronic serum uses existing small-batch production at low holding cost, and one year of results does not yet show that its value will not be realized, so keeping the option is justified.
A cleansing milk is a staple that complements the facial care range and costs little to keep on the market, so there is no evidence yet that warrants abandoning it.
